name: ASL modern band me rakho
when: Fast-paced popular-format video ki shot planning/cutting par
action: Average shot length lagbhag 3-6 second ke band me rakho; isse kahin lambi stretches modern audience ko slow/old lagti hain
why: Cutting ke 150-film corpus (1935-2005) me ASL ~15s se ~3.5s tak gira aur hit films isi band ki taraf evolve hui
frequency: Poori video ka average is band me; individual shots isse bahar ja sakte hain
evidence_note: Measurement 🟢 hai (peer-reviewed corpus), lekin 'is band se retention badhega' ek inference hai, A/B test nahi

name: Metronome cut kabhi nahi, lehren (waves) banao
when: Consecutive shots ki length sequence set karte waqt
action: Shot lengths ko fixed beat par mat rakho; paas wale shots ek jaise lambai ke hon, lekin sequence me chhote shots ke clusters bade stretches ke andar neste hue waves (1/f jaisi rhythm) banein
why: Modern films ki shot-length sequence human attention ke natural 1/f fluctuation pattern ki taraf evolve hui hai
frequency: Poori video par lagu; lambi ek-jaisee length wali run = violation
evidence_note: 1/f pattern corpus me measured 🟢 hai; use editing rule banana application-level inference hai

name: Climax par shots chhote, payoff ke baad lambe
when: Sequence apne climax/payoff ki taraf badh rahi ho
action: Payoff ke paas jaate jaate shots progressively chhote karo aur motion badhao; payoff ke baad shots lambe karo taaki moment land kare
why: Cutting ke 'evolution of pace' pattern ke mutabiq films climax ki taraf pace accelerate karti hain
frequency: Har bade payoff/climax par ek baar
evidence_note: Ye pattern sirf search-result abstract me dikha, paper full nahi khula — UNVERIFIED-in-full, isliye pakka 🟢 nahi

name: Frame declutter — closer, saaf framing
when: Kisi frame me competing subjects ya clutter ho
action: Closer aur cleaner framing chuno — frame me elements kam rakho taaki dhyaan ek jagah rahe
why: Cutting ke programme me century-lambi trend fewer elements per frame ki hai; ye attention control hai, fashion nahi
evidence_note: Trend measured hai; 'isiliye retention badhega' application inference hai
conflict_note: Tim Smith ke 'one magnet per shot' (C-007, 🟢) se milta-julta hai — wahan dhyaan do

name: Cut motion par — action shuru hone ke just baad
when: Kisi action ke beech me cut lagana ho
action: Match-on-action: cut us pal ke just BAAD lagao jab action shuru ho chuka ho, taaki motion onset aankh ko cut ke paar le jaye; movement shuru hone se pehle ke dead moment me cut mat lagao
why: Cut natural attention shift ka kaam karta hai; motion onset gaze ko naye shot me carry karta hai aur cut invisible ho jata hai
evidence_note: Eye-tracking studies me measured aur replicate hua result; AToCC isi par bana peer-reviewed theory hai

name: Eye-trace landing — subject wahi jahan aankh hai
when: Cut ke baad wala shot compose/select karte waqt
action: Shot B ka main subject lagbhag usi screen area me rakho jahan shot A ke end par viewer ka focus tha (ya use sabse strong motion/face cue banao), taaki aankh ko cut ke baad dhundna na pade
why: Attentional synchrony: sab viewers ek saath ek hi jagah dekhte hain; sahi landing par cut mehsoos hi nahi hota
evidence_note: Gaze clustering frame-by-frame eye-tracking se measured, kai studies me replicated
conflict_note: Murch ka eye-trace criterion (C-017) yahi baat 🟠 craft ke roop me kehta hai; ye uska measured version hai

name: Ek shot = ek hi attentional magnet
when: Koi important shot design/select karte waqt
action: Shot ko EK dominant magnet do (face, motion onset, ya bolti awaaz) aur competing motion hatao; do magnets ladenge to synchrony tootegi
why: Dhyaan involuntary roop se motion/face/speech se khinchta hai; do competing cues gaze ko baant dete hain
frequency: Har shot par; khaaskar key beats par sakht
evidence_note: Motion-onset capture aur gaze clustering eye-tracking se measured hai

name: Cutting speed ki ceiling — re-fixation ka waqt do
when: Cutting rate bahut tez ho jaye (action montage, intensified style)
action: Itna tez mat kato ki viewer do cuts ke beech dobara fixate hi na kar paye; us point ke aage slow karo ya ek shot hold karo — zyada cuts wahan excitement nahi, fatigue aur habituation dete hain
why: Hyper-fast cutting me gaze centre-frame par jam jati hai, arousal flatten ho jata hai aur viewer bore hota hai (Smith ki Bond/Bay analyses)
frequency: Jab bhi cutting rate extreme ho; lambe tez sequences par khaas dhyaan
evidence_note: Centre-fixation collapse measured observation hai; 'fatigue/boredom' wala nishkarsh Smith ki apni interpretation hai
conflict_note: Tez-cadence wale dusre rules (jaise pattern interrupts) se takraav ho to ye ceiling jeetni chahiye — Step 3 confirm kare

name: Cut situation-change par lagao
when: Situation badle — nayi location, naya goal, naya character interaction me aaye, nayi cause/topic shuru ho
action: Cut exactly us boundary par lagao; wahan cut invisible lagta hai kyunki dimaag waisi hi apna event model update kar raha hota hai
why: Dimaag experience ko events me baant ta hai; boundary prediction fail hone par mehsoos hoti hai aur fMRI responses exactly unhi palon par aate hain
evidence_note: EST: Psychological Bulletin theory paper + film par fMRI study (n=24, The Red Balloon) — converging evidence

name: Mid-event flow ki hifazat — be-wajah cut nahi
when: Situation wahi hai, event chal raha hai, prediction smoothly chal raha hai
action: Bina wajah ke mid-event cut mat lagao; aisa cut viewer ko ek model-update par majboor karta hai jo use chahiye hi nahi tha — jolt/error jaisa lagta hai
why: Jab kuch nahi badla, dimaag ka event model stable hai; zabardasti ka cut usi stability ko todta hai
evidence_note: Segmentation automatic hai aur passive viewing me bhi hoti hai — behavioural + fMRI evidence
conflict_note: Pattern-interrupt rules (C-033/C-034) se satahi takraav hai; interrupt ek deliberate design hona chahiye, aadat nahi

name: Deliberate boundary = attention reset button
when: Dhyaan reset karna ho — naya section, reveal, topic change
action: Us point par jaanboojh kar ek saaf situation change design karo (jagah, insaan, goal ya cause visibly badle) aur cut exactly usi par lagao — ek brain 'update' kharch ho raha hai, use wahan kharch karo jahan fresh start chahiye
why: Boundary par dimaag purana model band karke naya kholta hai — yahi natural fresh-start moment hai
evidence_note: Boundary responses situation changes se statistically mediated hain (Frontiers 2010 film study)

name: Ek baar me ek hi dimension badlo
when: Boundary banana ho
action: Place, people, goal, cause — ek baar me ek hi dimension badlo; chaaron ek saath badalna hard reset hai, wo climax ya naye chapter ke liye bachao, aadat mat banao
why: Zyada simultaneous situation change = zyada strong boundary response; roz-marra me ye disorientation banta hai
frequency: Har boundary par; hard reset sirf bade moments par
evidence_note: Mediation result 🟢 hai, lekin 'ek baar me ek, baaki bachao' wali dosage editorial inference hai

name: Chunk = ek event
when: Content structure karte waqt — topics, steps, scenes, chapters
action: Har chunk ko exactly ek event banao jiska saaf beginning aur end ho; adha-event ya do-event wala chunk mat banao
why: Viewer ki memory inhi event chunks me store hoti hai — ragged chunks matlab ragged recall
evidence_note: Boundaries baad me yaad rehne wali cheezon ko predict karti hain — memory experiments ka result
conflict_note: Chapters wale rule (C-046) se milta hai — chapter bhi ek event hona chahiye

name: Murch 1 — Emotion sabse upar (51%)
when: Koi bhi cut chunna ho, khaaskar jahan criteria takrate hon
action: Cut pehle is sawal se test karo: 'ye is moment ki emotion ke sach hai? audience ko kya mehsoos karana hai?' Emotion fail ho to cut reject/flag karo — EMOTION CHECK ENGINE KE BAHAR HAI: aise cut ko human check ke liye flag karo, engine khud emotion judge nahi karega
why: Murch ke hisaab se emotion akela (51%) baaki paanch criteria ke kul (49%) se zyada bhaari hai; emotion sahi ho to audience neeche ki khaamiyan notice hi nahi karti
frequency: Har cut par; emotion-veto ke roop me — technically perfect lekin emotion todne wala cut bhi reject
evidence_note: Ek master editor ki craft raay; Murch khud percentages ko 'slightly tongue-in-cheek' kehta hai — koi experiment nahi
conflict_note: User ke order (Kahani > Samajh > Rhythm > Style) me emotion Kahani ke andar band hai; Murch use Kahani se bhi upar rakhta hai — aur is system me emotion insaan ki aankh par hai, engine par nahi

name: Murch 2 — Story aage badhe (23%)
when: Cut ka faisla karte waqt
action: Wahi cut rakho jo kahani ko aage badhaye; jo cut kahani ko roke ya ghumaye, use neeche ke criteria (rhythm/continuity) ke liye mat bachao
why: Story dusra sabse bhaari criterion hai; emotion ke baad yahi cut ki asal justification hai
evidence_note: Craft wisdom, measured nahi (Murch, In the Blink of an Eye)

name: Murch 3 — Rhythm sahi pal par (10%)
when: Cut ka exact pal chunna ho
action: Cut us pal par lagao jo rhythmically 'sahi' lage — na jaldi, na der; rhythm story aur emotion ke neeche hai, unke upar kabhi nahi
why: Rhythm teesra criterion hai; top-3 (emotion+story+rhythm) aapas me gehri tarah jude hain
evidence_note: Craft wisdom; rhythm ka hona measured hai (Cutting/Smith) lekin ye weight Murch ki raay hai

name: Murch 4 — Eye-trace ka khayaal (7%)
when: Cut aur composition ka faisla karte waqt
action: Dekho ki audience ka focus frame me kahan aur kis taraf move kar raha hai, aur cut usi trace ko acknowledge kare
why: Eye-trace chautha criterion hai — cut ke paar nazar ka safar smooth rahe to cut ghulta hai
evidence_note: Murch ki raay 🟠 hai, lekin isi baat ko Smith ke eye-tracking ne baad me measure karke 🟢 support diya (C-006)

name: Murch 5 — 2-D plane / screen direction (5%)
when: Cut par stage line ya screen direction ka sawal aaye
action: Screen ki 2-D grammar (stage line, screen direction) ka samman karo — lekin ye upar ke chaar criteria ke liye qurban ho sakta hai
why: Planarity paanchva criterion hai; iska kaam asli 3-D space ko 2-D screen par padhne layak rakhna hai
evidence_note: Craft wisdom, koi measurement nahi

name: Murch 6 — 3-D space continuity (4%)
when: Characters ki asal spatial positions ka sawal aaye
action: Asli 3-D space ki continuity rakho jab muft me mile; ye sabse halka criterion hai — sabse pehle yahi qurban hoga
why: Sirf 4% weight: perfect spatial continuity bhi emotion-fail cut ko nahi bacha sakti, aur audience engaged ho to spatial jumps notice hi nahi karti
frequency: Har spatial cut par, sabse kam priority
evidence_note: Murch ki raay; audience ke spatial details na notice karne wali baat ko Smith ke attention findings se partial support milta hai

name: Murch meta — all-six pehle, qurbani neeche se upar
when: Do candidate cuts takrayein aur trade-off majboori ho
action: Pehle wo cut dhundo jo chhah criteria pure kare; na mile to neeche se upar qurbani do: 3-D space pehle, phir 2-D plane, phir eye-trace, phir rhythm, phir story — emotion kabhi nahi. Upar wala criterion neeche wale ke liye kabhi mat chhodo
why: Hierarchy sirf forced trade-offs ke liye hai; Murch: 'never accept less when more is available'
evidence_note: Craft framework; percentages pedagogical device hain, measurements nahi
conflict_note: User ke apne Order (Kahani > Samajh aana > Rhythm > Style/Effect) se qareebi rishta hai, lekin ek farak: Murch Emotion ko Story se strictly upar rakhta hai, user ke order me emotion Kahani ke andar/insaan ke paas hai — Step 3 me ye faisla final hoga

name: Greeting/intro se open kabhi nahi
when: Kisi bhi video (long-form ya Short) ki shuruaat likhte/edit karte waqt
action: 'Hey guys, welcome back', channel intro, logo sting, subscribe pitch — kuch bhi hook se pehle mat rakho. Pehli cheez viewer promise/payoff sune ya dekhe
why: Greeting cliff seconds ko khaali cheez par kharch karta hai; subscribe pitch abhi earn hi nahi hua; teeno sources isey sabse aam opening galti mante hain
frequency: Har video ki shuruaat par, bina exception
evidence_note: Teenon skills ki shared craft rule; koi measured study nahi

name: Pehle 30 second ki beat structure
when: Long-form video ka opening design karte waqt
action: 0-3s: cold line/clip — promise ya peak moment, koi greeting nahi. 0:03-0:10 (der se der 0:10 tak): title ka promise apni awaaz me restate karo. 0:10-0:18: stakes/obstacle naam karke loop kholo. 0:18-0:28: watch-contract — 'by the end you will...'. 0:28-0:30: body me hard pivot. Pehle 15s me teeno kaam pure hon: click confirm, aisa sawaal jo viewer band na kar paye, payoff ke saboot ki jhalak. Main point ki setup 2-minute mark se pehle screen par ho
why: Pehle 30s retention cliff hai — sabse zyada viewers yahi jaate hain; promise confirm na ho to viewer 0:08 par nikal jata hai
evidence_note: Teenon sources ki beat timings aapas me milti hain (Jake 15s ke 3 kaam, SkillMedev 30s cliff, serge ki beat table) — craft consensus, controlled study nahi
conflict_note: Jake hook ko 15s kehta hai, SkillMedev/serge 30s — takraav nahi: 15s hook ka core hai, 30s puri beat structure; dono is rule me jode gaye hain

name: Hook ko score karo — weakest property fix karo
when: Hook finalize karne se pehle
action: Har hook ko 5 properties par 0-100 score karo: Specificity, Address, Stakes, Curiosity, Brevity. Verdict = 60% mean + 40% sabse kamzor property. Sabse kamzor property ko fix karo (specificity kam = adjective hata ke number/naam/date; address kam = pehle 6 shabdon me 'you'; stakes kam = lagat naam karo; curiosity kam = khud jawab dene wala hissa kato; brevity kam = saans rukne wali jagah par roko). Low score = dobara dekho; high score = vaada kabhi mat samjho
why: Ek dead property wala hook usi property par leak karta hai; average use chhupa deta hai — isliye weakest-link weighting
frequency: Har hook par, recording se pehle
evidence_note: hookscore.py 74 real short-form hooks par calibrate hua (top-8/bottom-8 by views, 5 channels); kharab hooks ko asli se alag karta hai, lekin ek hi creator ke hits vs misses ko mushkil se alag karta hai — isliye 🟡, 🟢 nahi

name: Hook ki lambai 9-24 shabd
when: Spoken hook line likhte waqt
action: Hook line 9-24 shabdon ke band me rakho — ~150 wpm par ye 10 second ke andar boli ja sakne wali lambai hai. Isse chhoti = signal kam, lambi = saans aur dhyaan dono khatm
why: hookscore.py ka brevity band calibrated hooks ke data se aaya hai
evidence_note: 74-hook calibration set se derived band hai
conflict_note: Shorts ke spoken hook ke liye SkillMedev ki limit aur sakht hai (<12 shabd, C-037) — Shorts par wahi jeetegi

name: Hook variants banao, test karke chuno
when: Kisi video ka hook tay karte waqt
action: Ek hook par mat ruko: long-form ke liye 5 hooks likho, score karke top 2 rakho aur dono dikhao; kam se kam 3 variants, har ek alag formula se, taaki A/B test ho sake aur pattern seekha ja sake. Sabse badhiya hook pehla draft lagbhag kabhi nahi hota
why: Variants ki tulna hi asli pasand batati hai; ek hook dena = andaza lagana
evidence_note: Dono sources ki workflow rule; koi measurement nahi

name: Cold-open payoff tease — result pehle, setup baad me
when: Video me ek dramatic moment/result maujud ho (build, transformation, reveal)
action: Sabse dramatic moment ya result ka 3-8 second ka flash sabse pehle dikhao, phir setup par cut karo — viewer wahan tak kaise pahunche, ye dekhne ke liye rukta hai. Tease kiya moment asal me video me hona chahiye aur intezaar ke layak bhi
why: Destination pehle dikhane se dheema hissa bik jata hai; setup par wapas cut hi khula loop hai
frequency: Har suitable video par ek baar, opening me
evidence_note: serge Y8 + Jake ke 'The Reveal' formula + SkillMedev Before/After — craft pattern

name: Vaada imandari — title/hook ka promise pehle 30s me cash ho
when: Title, thumbnail aur hook finalize karte waqt
action: Title/hook jo promise kare, video ka pehla hissa use imandari se pura kare — hook us payoff se zyada mat wada kare jo video de sakta hai. Inflate kiya hook ek view kharidta hai aur channel ka bharosa kharch karta hai; tez click-away ranking penalty hai
why: YouTube satisfied watch-time optimize karta hai: CTR x retention; over-promise wala click fast bounce me badalta hai aur modest title se zyada mehnga padta hai
evidence_note: serge ke heuristics YouTube ke public Creator Insider statements par adharit synthesis hain; baaki do sources bhi yahi rule dete hain

name: Promised artifact 20 second ke andar screen par
when: Hook/title ne koi cheez dikhane ka vaada kiya ho (prompt, screenshot, result, tool)
action: Wo artifact 20 second ke andar screen par dikhao. Reveal 8 minute par rakha to 1 minute par retention cliff pakka hai
why: Vaada kiya saboot jaldi na mile to hook clickbait padhta hai
evidence_note: hooks.json ki rule; craft heuristic

name: Turn (0:15-0:45) — ek sentence me plan
when: Hook ke baad body shuru hone se pehle
action: Ek sentence me batao video kya karne wala hai, aur karna shuru kar do. Channel intro, 'before we get started', subscribe pitch — kuch nahi; yehi 0:30 cliff ki sabse aam wajah hai
why: Viewer ko roadmap milta hai bina waqt kharch hue; throat-clearing sidha drop-off hai
evidence_note: yt-script ki structure rule

name: Ek beat = ek idea, on-screen bhi mark karo
when: Body ki beats likhte/edit karte waqt
action: Har beat me sirf ek idea rakho, aur har beat ke saath likho ki screen par kya dikhega — sirf bolta sir (talking head) bina dekhe jaane wali cheez ke podcast hai, video nahi
why: Ek beat me do ideas dono ko kamzor karte hain; visual mark editor ko aur viewer dono ko orientation deta hai
evidence_note: yt-script ki craft rule; SkillMedev ke inline [B-ROLL]/[GRAPHIC] cues bhi yahi kehte hain

name: Har beat: mini-hook + delivery + bridge (loop zinda)
when: Long-form body ko 3-5 beats me structure karte waqt
action: Har beat ke teen hisse rakho: shuruaat me mini-hook (is beat ka micro-promise), phir point ki delivery, phir bridge jo agle beat me ek loop khole. Kisi bhi pal kam se kam 1 open loop zinda rakho
why: Bina bridge ke beats 'and then' ki chain banti hai; khula loop hi viewer ko agle beat tak kheenchta hai
frequency: 3-5 beats per video; har pal ≥1 loop zinda
evidence_note: SkillMedev youtube-script-writer ki architecture rule

name: Midpoint par re-engagement trigger
when: Video ke beech wale beat par
action: Beech me jaanboojh kar ek re-engagement trigger lagao — 'but here's the thing' jaisa mod ya stakes-raise — kyunki midpoint cliff ke baad dusra sabse bada drop-off hai
why: Unstructured body beech me ek-ek karke viewers kho deti hai; midpoint ka mod curve ko dobara uthata hai
frequency: Har long-form video me ek baar, midpoint par
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki craft claim; drop-off ranking ka koi cited dataset nahi

name: Pattern interrupt har 90-120 second
when: Long-form body chalte waqt
action: Har 90-120 second me ek pattern interrupt lagao: naya camera angle, bold on-screen graphic, rhetorical question, ya chhoti story. 150 wpm par ye har 225-300 shabdon me ek hai. Script me [PATTERN INTERRUPT] flag karo taaki editor use jaanboojh kar lagaye, accident se nahi
why: Ek jaisi presentation par dhyaan decay hota hai; interrupt attention reset karta hai
frequency: Har 90-120s; poori video me barabar phaila hua
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki timing rule; koi measured study cited nahi
conflict_note: Isi cluster ke CraigHewitt (cluster B) wale 15-30s cadence se ye bahut dheema hai, aur slopstudio ke flat-pacing se tez — Step 3 is takraav ka faisla karega

name: Har section break par re-hook
when: Long-form me natural section break aaye; khaas taur par 30-60s ke aas-paas
action: Har section break par chhota re-hook lagao: aane wali cheez ki ek-line tease ('lekin teesri wali ne asal me numbers hilaye'), ya pattern interrupt (B-roll cut, location change, on-screen callout), ya ek chhota payoff bump jo curve uthaye. 30-60s ke paas ek re-hook lazmi rakho
why: Retention sirf pehle 30s me nahi rehta; flat/rising curve suggested placement dilata hai
frequency: Har section break par; 30-60s par ek pakka
evidence_note: serge retention-beats ki rule
conflict_note: C-033 (har 90-120s interrupt) se sambandhit hai lekin placement logic alag hai — ye waqt par nahi, section boundaries par lagta hai

name: Payoff over-deliver karo — bonus insight lazmi
when: Video ka ending/payoff likhte waqt
action: Payoff hook ke vaade se zyada de: har beat ka takeaway ek sentence me recap karo, phir ek bonus insight do jo hook me zikr hi nahi tha. Yahi surplus santusht viewer ko subscriber banata hai aur end-screen retention uthata hai. Abrupt end mat karo — outro bhi retention signal hai
why: Promise se zyada milna hi 'satisfied watch' hai jise ranker optimize karta hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki payoff rule; Jake bhi payoff ko explicitly deliver karne ko kehta hai

name: Ek hi CTA — ek hi ask
when: Video ke close par
action: Sirf EK specific ask rakho, video ke topic se juda (jaise 'pricing script neeche link hai'). Subscribe-like-comment-bell ki string kabhi nahi; generic subscribe ask bhi nahi
why: Kai asks dhyaan baant dete hain; ek topic-specific ask convert karta hai
evidence_note: Teenon sources ki shared rule

name: Shorts spoken hook 12 shabdon se kam
when: Short/Reel/TikTok ka spoken hook likhte waqt
action: Spoken hook line 12 shabdon ke neeche rakho — lambi line speaking pace par 3-second window se aage nikal jati hai. Line ek specific claim kare, vague nahi
why: Short-form me pehle 3 second hi poora audition hai; har shabd ko apni jagah kamani padti hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev video-hook-writer ki hard limit
conflict_note: Long-form hook ke liye band 9-24 shabd hai (C-024); Shorts par ye sakht limit jeetegi

name: Shorts overlay — dusra hook, 5-7 shabd
when: Short-form hook ke saath on-screen text lagate waqt
action: Overlay 5-7 shabdon me rakho; spoken line ki tamam — wahi promise, alag shabd — taaki sound-on aur muted dono viewers ko pura hook mile
why: Autoplay aksar muted chalta hai; overlay hi muted viewer ka hook hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki rule; Jake bhi Shorts ke pehle 2s ke liye spoken se alag shabdon wala on-screen text kehta hai

name: Frame one bina awaaz ke kaam kare
when: Short-form/social video ka pehla frame tay karte waqt
action: Frame one par payoff result, bold caption line, ya subject mid-action dikhao. Black frame, logo sting, slow zoom, slow fade, aur bina context ka talking head — sab banned. Frame 0 hi thumbnail aur scroll-stopper hai
why: Autoplay muted hota hai; pehla frame 'kuch hai yahan' kehne me fail ho to scroll pakka hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev (video-hook-writer + social-video-formatter) aur serge (Y10/retention beats) ki shared rule

name: Short ke liye self-contained 20-55s moment
when: Long video se Short kaatna ho
action: Sirf wahi 20-55 second ka span chuno jo: (1) complete thought se khule (pehli line ko pichla minute na chahiye ho), (2) usme ek turn ho (claim, phir use complicate/prove karne wali cheez), (3) ek line par khatm ho, trail-off par nahi. Short ke liye NAYI pehli line likho (purani line context maangti hai jo is viewer ke paas nahi) aur score karo
why: 'Best moment' ka clip aksar context ke bina marta hai; survive wahi karta hai jo akele khada ho
frequency: Har candidate Short par teeno shartein lazmi
evidence_note: yt-shorts ki selection rule

name: Loop design jaanboojh kar chuno
when: Short-form video ka ending design karte waqt
action: Teen me se ek loop type chun kar design karo: seamless (last frame = first frame — position, scale, color same), hook-back (aakhri line/visual viewer ko shuruaat par wapas bheje), ya hard stop (puri kahani ke liye saaf CTA end card). Loop apne aap par mat chhodo
why: Feed turant replay karta hai; deliberate loop muft ka extra watch-time hai aur loop-through Shorts ka sabse mazboot signal mana jata hai
frequency: Har Short par ek type, jaanboojh kar
evidence_note: SkillMedev social-video-formatter + serge Y10 + Jake yt-shorts (loop point) — teenon sources

name: Dead air trim — gap beech se, saansein bacha kar
when: Transcript se edit decision list banate waqt
action: Spoken cues ke beech floor (default 0.45s) se bade gaps ko BEECH se trim karo — dono taraf breath bache (floor/2 each side). Speech se chipka kar cut karne se take gasping lagta hai
why: Dead air pacing ko marta hai, lekin zero-breath cut bhi unnatural lagta hai; beech se trim dono bacha leta hai
frequency: Har gap > 0.45s par (floor badla ja sakta hai)
evidence_note: deadair.py ka default floor aur trim logic — tool author ki craft setting
conflict_note: Pause ke teen alag model is cluster me hain: ye (floor + beech-trim), blazerior ka remainder 0.2-0.3s (C-072), pifferologo ke silence thresholds + padding (C-091/C-092) — Step 3 me ek model final hoga

name: Filler-only cues hatao
when: Transcript clean karte waqt
action: Jo cue sirf filler hai ('um', 'so yeah', 'basically', 'you know') use poora hatao — wo koi information nahi deta
why: Filler-only hissa sirf runtime aur susti badhata hai
evidence_note: deadair.py ki FILLER category
conflict_note: Dhyaan: filler HATAO sirf jab cue sirf filler ho; bolne ki natural texture bachane wali baat dusre cluster (PandaStudio) me hai — takraav Step 3 dekhega

name: Retake/restart pehchano aur kato
when: Ek hi sentence dobara shuru hui ho
action: Restart ko pichle ASAL speech cue se compare karo (beech wala 'um' cue asli pichla nahi hota); pehle 5 shabd match hon to pehli koshish hatao, dusri rakho
why: Zyada tar retakes ke beech ek filler hota hai — literal pichle cue se compare karne se wo miss ho jate hain
evidence_note: deadair.py ki REPEAT detection logic

name: Retention diagnosis — leak, cliff, slide alag ilaaj
when: Publish hue video ki retention report padhte waqt
action: Teen problems ko alag pehchano: HOOK LEAK (pehle 30s ka nuksan; 25% se kam = healthy; ilaaj hamesha pehli 15s ki script hai, edit nahi), CLIFFS (ek tez drop = ek moment — bina signpost ka topic change, sponsor read, lamba setup; transcript se dekho wahan kya kaha ja raha tha), SLIDE (beech ka steady bleed = pacing; ilaaj cutting hai, rewriting nahi). Sabse bada ek leak naam karke ek hi badlav batao
why: Teeno ke kaaran aur ilaaj alag hain; galat diagnosis galat fix deta hai
evidence_note: retention.py ke thresholds (25%/40% bands, 0.8% cliff) tool author ke heuristics hain, published study nahi

name: Chapters ke platform niyam
when: Description me chapters likhte waqt
action: Pehla chapter 00:00 par, kam se kam 3 chapters, har chapter kam se kam 10 second ka. Har chapter ka title topic-words nahi, us section ka promise ho — 3-5 shabdon me, creator ki awaaz me. Jo section 5 shabdon me naam na paye, wo ya do sections hai ya filler hai
why: Inme se ek bhi niyam toota to chapter block render hi nahi hota — description me pada reh jata hai; chapters retention diagnostic bhi hain
frequency: Har long-form video par (Shorts par chapters nahi)
evidence_note: 00:00/3+/10s YouTube ke apne documented rules hain — platform spec; 3-5 shabd wala promise-title hissa craft hai

name: Bolne ki raftaar budget — 150 wpm
when: Script ki lambai aur beat ki timing tay karte waqt
action: Script ko 150 words per minute par budget karo; instruction/narration ke liye band 140-160 wpm hai. Har beat ke shabd uske time budget se zyada na hon — 8 second ka beat ~20 shabd hai, 50 nahi
why: Isse tez bolna follow karne walon ko peeche chhod deta hai; budget hi beat sheet ko sach banata hai
evidence_note: Dono sources ka shared convention (Jake runtime estimate, SkillMedev beat sheet + narration pace)

name: Narration-action sync — ek instruction, ek action
when: Tutorial/demo ki voiceover likhte waqt
action: Ek on-screen action ke liye ek hi instruction; shabd action ke saath ya ek beat pehle land hon — jo click ho chuka, use narrate mat karo ('ab humne save kar liya' save ke baad dead air hai). Screen par kuch complex ho raha ho to bolna roko aur visual ko saans lene do
why: Viewer ek saath kar bhi raha hai aur sun bhi raha hai; peeche chali narration aur aage badha visual dono ko harate hain
evidence_note: SkillMedev narration-script ki cardinal rule

name: Har step ka shape: Goal → Action → Confirmation
when: Tutorial ke steps likhte waqt
action: Har step teen hisso me rakho: Goal (kya karne wale hain aur kyun), Action (ek concrete instruction), Confirmation (success kaisa dikhega). Steps ke beech halki signposting rakho. On-screen UI labels bilkul wasi bolo jase button par likha hai — button 'New project' kehta hai to 'create a project' mat bolo
why: Shape viewer ko har pal oriented rakhta hai; label mismatch seedha confusion hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev narration-script ki structure rule

name: Paach-beat spine (demo/launch videos)
when: Demo, announcement ya launch video plan karte waqt
action: Paach beats is order me rakho: Hook (pehle 3s — result/tension/claim, logo NAHI) → Problem (ek concrete dard) → Reveal (cheez kaam karti hui) → Proof (asli number/before-after, invented metric kabhi nahi) → CTA (ek action, ek URL). Beat sirf wajah ke saath drop karo; hook ke baad order mat badlo. Lambi walkthrough me Reveal+Proof har feature par repeat hota hai, Hook/Problem/CTA ek hi rehte hain
why: Ye order viewer ke faisle ki seedhi hai: rukna, dard pehchanna, jawab dekhna, yakeen karna, kadam uthana
evidence_note: SkillMedev video-storyboard ki spine rule

name: Scene-type ke hisaab se duration
when: Storyboard me har scene ki lambai tay karte waqt
action: Scene type se duration do: Hook/title card 2.5-3.5s; Text statement 2.5-4s (padhne ki speed ~2.5 shabd/sec — 7-shabd line ko ~3s chahiye); UI/product demo 4-6s (aankh ko dwell time chahiye); Proof/data 3-5s; Logo/CTA outro 2.5-4s. Hook sabse tez cut, Proof sabse slow. Total lamba ho to ek scene KATO — har scene ko speed up mat karo, rushed video nervous lagta hai
why: Alag scene types ko alag samay chahiye; flat ek-jaisa pacing slideshow banata hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev video-storyboard ki duration table (30fps par)

name: Scene order causality par — therefore/but, and-then nahi
when: Beats/scenes ka order tay karte waqt
action: Har beat pichle se caused ho aur agle ko cause kare — 'therefore / but' ki chain banao. 'And then, and then' wali chain sagging story ki structural nishani hai; sag ko naye events jod kar mat sudharo, connectives dobara banao
why: Causality hi woh cheez hai jo sequence ko kahani banati hai; bina uske beech hamesha sag karega
evidence_note: SkillMedev story-structure-architect ki diagnostic rule (fiction se aayi, video structure par lagu)

name: Load-bearing turns ki jagah (percentages)
when: Lambi kahani/format ki macro structure banate waqt
action: Bade turns ko in hisson ke aas-paas rakho: inciting incident pehle 10-12% ke andar; first-act break / point of no return ~20-25%; midpoint ~50% (reversal jo stakes uthaye aur goal ko recontextualize kare — sirf time mark karne wala midpoint sag ki jad hai); all-is-lost ~75-80%; phir climax aur resolution. First-act break 30% ke paar ya midpoint 60% ki taraf sarka ho to interrogate karo
why: Ye jagahen darshak ki umeedon ki ghadi se mili hui hain; mod der se aaye to beech ka hissa dheela padta hai
evidence_note: Percentages guides hain, law nahi — source khud kehta hai; screenwriting craft convention
conflict_note: Video par ye percentages seedha copy karna Step 3 me tay hoga — short/mid-form par ye scale badal sakta hai

name: Setups aur payoffs ka audit
when: Structure deliver/final karne se pehle
action: Har payoff (twist, reveal, capability, object) ki list banao aur confirm karo wo pehle fairly plant hua hai — telegraph kiye bina. Har prominent setup ko dekho: ya payoff kare ya cut ho. Bina chalayi banduk (loaded gun) mat chhodo; bina plant kiya payoff kahin se mat lao. Coincidence protagonist ko museebat me daal sakta hai, use bacha kabhi nahi sakta
why: Unplanted payoff dhokha lagta hai, unpaid setup jhoothi ummeed; dono bharosa todte hain
frequency: Har structure par, delivery se pehle ek pass
evidence_note: story-structure-architect ki diagnostic checklist

name: Tension curve — chadhai ke saath jaanboojh ki ghaatiyan
when: Poori video/kahani ki tension map karte waqt
action: Tension ko beat-by-beat upar chadhate hue rakho, beech me saans ke liye deliberate valleys ke saath. Flatline = sag; shuru me hi max out = aage chadhne ki jagah nahi. Do paas wale beats ek hi intensity par hon to ek ko vary ya reorder karo; har bada turn pichle se zyada stakes uthaye
why: Curve hi viewer ki urja ka budget hai; ek-jaisi intensity aadat (habituation) ban jati hai
frequency: Har structure par ek diagnostic pass
evidence_note: story-structure-architect ki tension diagnostic; Cutting ke waves (C-002) se taal-mel hai lekin ye kahani-level par lagta hai, shot-level par nahi

name: Thesis-breakdown format (runtime ke hisse)
when: Expert talking-head monologue ko format karte waqt
action: Runtime ko in hisson me baanto: 0-8% Hook (sawaal wala hook title), 8-13% Rebuttal (kata hua shabd/mithak), 13-23% Cause (thesis card), 23-38% Mechanism (diagram), 38-54% Breakdown (ek-ek karke bullets), 54-64% Turn (saaf speaker — saans ki jagah), 64-77% Consequences, 77-86% Climax (pull quote + maximum zoom), 86-100% Ending (CTA). 73s ke monologue par validate hua format hai
why: Ye hissa-bandhwari viewer ko har charan par 'main kahan hu' ka jawab deti hai aur climax ke liye jagah bachati hai
evidence_note: blazerior storyboard ki ek video (73s→68s) par validated format table

action: Formulas me se chuno: Y1 Curiosity-Gap, Y2 Number/Listicle, Y3 How-I Outcome, Y4 Mistake/Negativity, Y5 Transformation, Y6 Versus, Y11 Third-Party Success Story. Corpus me Y1/Y3/Y5 confirmed over-performers hain (214-video pull); Y11 sabse zyada frequent uncaptured shape tha. Har title me curiosity ke saath ek concrete noun rakho; number wala dawa sach aur apna ho
conflict_note: Y2/Y4/Y6 is corpus me kamzor ya gayab mile (Y4 aur Y6 business niche me essentially absent) — ye formulas gear/tutorial niches me kaam kar sakte hain, lekin 'proven' mat mano
evidence_note: 214-video corpus (July 2026, business/creator niche, subscriber-normalized) me Y1/Y3/Y5 validated aur Y11 discover hua — measured corpus, controlled experiment nahi; sirf title formulas is data se test ho sakte hain, opening hooks nahi
frequency: Har title par 1 formula; 3-5 variants kam se kam 2 formulas se
name: Title formulas — corpus-validated ko pehle
when: Title likhte waqt formula chunna ho
why: Formula hi title ko summary se promise banata hai; corpus validation batata hai kaunse shapes asal me over-perform karte hain

action: Hard cap 100 characters; sweet spot 40-60 rakho. Click decide karne wale shabd SABSE PEHLE rakho (colon se pehle) — desktop search ~60 par aur mobile home feed ~40 par truncate karta hai; mobile truncation subject ko hi kaat sakta hai
evidence_note: Truncation points platform behaviour hain (dono sources me documented); sweet spot craft recommendation hai
name: Title ki lambai aur front-loading
when: Title finalize karte waqt
why: Truncation dono jagah alag tareeke se fail karta hai — desktop par tail jata hai, mobile par subject ja sakta hai

action: Ek number, naam ya date rakho — ye har adjective ko harata hai. Vague shabd (amazing, incredible, insane, ultimate, best, secret...) hatao. Pehle 3 shabd sirf filler na hon — subject aage lao. Title sawaal par khatm ho to open question ka plus milta hai
conflict_note: All-caps par sources me halka farak: Jake ceiling 2 caps shabd deta hai, serge full-caps title banned aur 1 emphasized shabd tak rakhta hai — sakht wala (serge) surakshit rahega
evidence_note: title.py ke checks + serge ki voice rules — craft heuristics
name: Title ki samagri — number/naam/date, vague shabd nahi
when: Title ke shabd chunte waqt
why: Concreteness hi click ka sabse bharosemand single fix hai; vagueness andaza lagwati hai

action: Ek hi focal point rakho (face + specific emotion, ya object/result). Emotion video ki asal feeling se match kare — shaant tutorial par shocked face retention se mehnga padega. High contrast aur subject separation rakho (rim light, darkened/blurred background). Har concept ko 120px par shrink karke dekho: wahan padhna aaye tabhi pass. 3 se zyada visual elements kabhi nahi
evidence_note: Teenon sources ke thumbnail rules ka sangam; 120px test teeno me hai
name: Thumbnail core — ek focal point, sachhi emotion, 120px test
when: Thumbnail concept banate waqt
why: Thumbnail aadhe second me, 120px par, ek darjan competitors ke beech padha jata hai; do competing subjects impact aadha kar dete hain

action: Overlay ke shabd title ke shabdon se bilkul alag rakho — dono aadhi click surface ek hi baat do baar keh kar barbaad karte hain. Lambai ka target 3 shabd rakho. Text bottom-right third me kabhi nahi (duration badge dhakta hai). Ek emphasis shabd all-caps/color me chalega
conflict_note: Shabd-limit par sources takrate hain: Jake '3 maximum' kehta hai (tool 4 par flag karta hai), serge '4 ya kam', SkillMedev '2-5, target 3, hard ceiling 5'. Target 3 sab me surakshit hai; Step 3 ek number final kare
evidence_note: Teenon sources overlay ko title se alag rakhne par ekmat hain; ginati par farak hai (neeche conflict dekho)
name: Thumbnail text — target 3 shabd, title se alag
when: Thumbnail par text overlay likhte waqt
why: Title aur thumbnail ek unit hain; duplication aadhi jagah ki barbaadi hai, aur feed size par chautha-paanchva shabd grey smear ban jata hai

action: Hamesha 2-3 concepts banao (jaise face-forward / object-result / text-heavy minimal) aur har concept me sirf EK bada element badlo (face vs object, text vs no-text, warm vs cool color) taaki Test & Compare ka result padhne layak ho. Ek lead concept recommend karo — jeet watch-time share se naapo, sirf CTR se nahi
evidence_note: serge + SkillMedev ki shared workflow rule
name: Thumbnail ke 2-3 concepts, ek bada element vary karo
when: Thumbnail finalize karne se pehle
why: Ek concept dena andaza hai; ek-saath paanch chhoti cheezein badalne se test kuch nahi batata

action: Pehli ~150 characters ko dusra hook banao: payoff ya sawaal + primary keyword natural tareeke se. Yehi 'Show more' se pehle dikhta hai aur search snippet hai. Kul lambai 5,000 characters ke neeche. Keywords natural sentences me (primary phrase pehle 150 me ek baar, body me ek baar), comma-dump kabhi nahi. Hashtags aakhir me 3-5; 15 se zyada hon to YouTube sab ignore kar deta hai. Tags sirf disambiguation ke liye, 15 kaafi
evidence_note: 5,000-char cap aur 150-char visibility platform ke documented behaviour hain; baaki structure craft hai
name: Description — pehle 150 characters hi hook
when: Description likhte waqt
why: Pehli lines ke alawa description zyada tar koi padhta hi nahi; wahi hissa search ko bhi khilati hai

action: Em dash lagbhag 1 per 100 shabd se zyada nahi (title/post me zyada se zyada 1); zyada hon to comma, colon ya line break lagao — period kabhi nahi. AI-vocabulary markers (leverage, significant, streamline, foster...) ek paragraph me 1 hai to English hai, 3 hon to poora paragraph dobara likho; ek-line title me ek bhi marker cluster hai. Sincerity openers ('let me be honest', 'not gonna lie') aur reveal bridges ('here's what nobody tells you') bina dated fact ke banned. Keywords stuff mat karo — asal search phrase ek baar, natural
evidence_note: serge bundle ki voice rules — house craft standard
frequency: Har text par, publish se pehle ek pass
name: Likhne ki safaai — em dash aur AI shabdawali ki hadd
when: Koi bhi publish hone wala text (title, description, script, post) likhte waqt
why: Density hi AI-likhai ki pehchan hai; stuffing ranking nahi deta, spam padhta hai

action: Mix stage ke hisaab se rakho: New (0-1k) 1 long-form + 4-5 Shorts; Growing (1k-50k) 1 long-form + 3 Shorts; Established (50k+) 1-2 long-form + 2-3 Shorts. Cadence wahi chuno jo kam se kam 12 hafte nibh sake — consistency volume ko harati hai. Har slot pre-paired ho: format, title angle, thumbnail angle, hook formula, goal (CTR/retention/subscribe — hafta teeno me banta ho, ek hi note nahi), posting window. Shorts ka long-form library se through-line lazmi. Ek anchor video hafte ka kendr, ek cheap video maujud cheez se, Shorts anchor se katein. Week slip ho to Short chhodo, long-form kabhi nahi
evidence_note: serge planner/pillars + Jake yt-plan ki cadence rules; ratios 'reported' starting points hain
frequency: Har hafte ke plan par; mix ka review har 4 hafte
name: Hafte ka mix — cadence jo 12 hafte chal sake
when: Upload plan/calendar banate waqt
why: Shorts reach laate hain, long-form watch-time aur wafadar subscriber; bina through-line ke dono audiences alag marte hain

action: Pehli line poora hook carry kare (feed truncate karta hai). Ek post = ek clear ask (vote, ek specific comment, ya video dekho) — do asks response baant dete hain. Poll: 2-4 options, mutually exclusive, koi false dilemma nahi. Hafte me 2-4 posts kaafi; lagbhag aadhi posts aane wale/recent video se judi hon (tease ya follow-up). Engagement bait ('comment 1 for yes') banned
evidence_note: serge community-post-writer ki rules
frequency: Hafte me 2-4; har post par ek ask
name: Community posts — pehli line hook, ek hi ask
when: Uploads ke beech community tab par post karte waqt
why: Community tab between-uploads ka touchpoint hai — channel ko garm rakhta hai aur agle video ke early signals seed karta hai

action: Trailer non-subscribers ke liye 30-90s ki bana-banayi pitch rakho (random recent upload nahi) — ye subscriber conversion ka sabse bada lever hai. Banner 2560x1440 par banao lekin value prop + cadence centered 1235x338 safe area ke andar rakho (mobile/TV par kinare cut te hain). About ki pehli 2 lines me poora value prop: kiske liye, kya milta hai, kitni baar, ek proof. Ek hi primary link rakho
evidence_note: serge channel-optimizer ki scorecard rules; banner dimensions platform spec hain
frequency: Channel setup par aur har audit par
name: Channel page — trailer, banner safe area, About ki pehli 2 lines
when: Channel page audit/setup karte waqt
why: Video se click karke aaya viewer ek pal me faisla karta hai; trailer/banner/About hi use subscriber banate hain

action: Comments ko themes me baanto; jo alag sawaal 3 ya zyada baar aaye, wahi next-video candidate hai — use potential title ke roop me naam do. Ek baar aaya comment trend nahi hota. Repeat commenters (superfans) ko naam se reply karo. Critical-but-specific comments sabse kaam ke hain — unhe dabao mat, surface karo. Pin us sawaal ko karo jo sabse zyada logon ka hai, sabse pyaare wale ko nahi
evidence_note: serge audience-insights + Jake yt-comment ki triage rules
frequency: Har video ke comments par ek pass
name: Comments se next video — 3+ baar wahi sawaal
when: Comments padh kar content ideas nikalte waqt
why: Comment section retention surface bhi hai aur demand signal bhi; dohraya sawaal hi sabit demand hai

action: Source ka shell utaaro aur ek claim/story/number (spine) nikalo. Payoff se lead karo — source ka hook lagbhag kabhi survive nahi karta, use dobara likho. Listicle/numbered thread description me chapters ban jata hai (ek item = ek chapter). Off-platform artifacts ('link in bio', hashtag walls, dusri jagah ke @-handles, 'as I posted on...') sab hatao. Source ke claim, facts aur numbers bilkul na badlo — delivery badalti hai, matlab nahi
evidence_note: serge repurposer ki native-fit rules
name: Repurpose — spine nikalo, copy-paste kabhi nahi
when: Blog/thread/post ko YouTube surface me badalna ho
why: Galat platform ka format YouTube par marta hai; shabdon ko nahi, point ko carry karna hi repurposing hai

action: Videos ko raw views se rank mat karo — har video ko uske APNE channel ke median views ke multiple se rank karo (default threshold 1.5x-2x). Jis channel ke 4 se kam videos jama hon, use skip karo — 1-2 videos ka median, median nahi hota. Har outlier ke title ka formula naam do, lekin yaad rakho: formula TITLE ke shabdon par judgement hai, video ke chalne ki wajah ka dawa nahi
evidence_note: swipe.py ki ranking method; statistical common sense, measured study nahi
name: Outlier research — channel ke apne median ka multiple
when: Niche me 'kya chal raha hai' research karte waqt
why: Raw views channel ka size naapte hain, idea ko nahi; median-multiple hi video ke baare me sawal ka jawab deta hai

action: Pauses kato, ideas kabhi nahi. Cut hamesha phrase ke end par lagao; 'har N second me cut' wala stopwatch tareeka ideas ko beech se kaat deta hai. Jahan subject move kar raha ho wahan cut mat lagao — majboori ho to us pal ko infographic card se dhako
conflict_note: pifferologo ke word-boundary rule (C-090) se milta hai lekin alag hai: ye phrase-level craft hai, wo word-level technical correctness
evidence_note: blazerior pipeline ki cutting rules — asal builds par seekhi hui
name: Cut phrase ke end par, stopwatch par nahi
when: Talking-head footage cut karte waqt
why: Talking-head me har sentence matlab uthata hai; aggressive cutting logic ko tod deta hai

action: Har pause ka 0.2-0.3 second hissa rehne do. Pause ko zero par collapse karna stutter jaisa sunai deta hai
conflict_note: Jake ke dead-air model (floor 0.45s, beech se trim, ~0.225s har taraf) se talab mel khata hai; pifferologo ke padding (30-200ms) aur silence thresholds (≥400ms clean) se numbers ki bhasha alag hai — Step 3 me ek model bane
evidence_note: blazerior ki build-tested rule
name: Har pause ka 0.2-0.3s bacha kar rakho
when: Pause trim karte waqt
why: Bolne ki natural saans hi take ko insaani rakhti hai; poori tarah chipka hua speech ghut ta hai

action: Use trim hi mat karo — wahan khamoshi hi kaam kar rahi hai (tension, ummeed, wazan)
conflict_note: Dead-air rules (C-042/C-092) ka ye jaanboojh kiya exception hai — engine ko dramatic pause pehchanna hoga ya human flag lagega
evidence_note: blazerior ki do jagah dohraayi hui rule
name: Dramatic pause ko haath mat lagao
when: Sawaal ke baad ya conclusion se pehle wala pause dikhe
why: Dramatic silence retention ka hissa hai, dead air nahi; use kaatna moment ko halka kar deta hai

action: Paas wale segments ke beech zoom alternate karo (jaise 1.00 / 1.045 / 1.09); climax par maximum zoom rakho. Isse cut angle badalne jaisa padhta hai, galti jaisa nahi
evidence_note: blazerior ki EDL practice (segments me zoom 1.00/1.045 pattern)
name: Zoom neighbouring segments me alternate karo
when: Cut par punch-in/zoom lagate waqt
why: Ek jaisa frame cut par 'jump' lagta hai; halka scale farak use deliberate choice bana deta hai

action: Har minute me kam se kam ek 4-6 second ka saaf stretch rakho jisme koi graphic na ho. Cards ki thos deewaar viewer ko thaka deti hai
evidence_note: blazerior ki do jagah (SKILL rule 7 + storyboard rhythm) dohraayi rule
name: Ek stretch bina graphics ke — viewer ko hawa do
when: Minute-bhar ke video me overlays/cards lagate waqt
why: Bina saans ki visual bharmar dhyaan ko hi kha jati hai; khaali stretch hi accents ko wazan deta hai

action: Card ko face ke UPAR (above) rakho, face ke upar (on) kabhi nahi — panel beech frame me gira to aankhein dhak jati hain, aur speaker ki nazar hi video ke bharose ka aadha hissa hai. Zones rakho: top 0-150 platform UI (kuch nahi), graphics ka working area 200-1250, face aam taur par 700-1300 (bahar rakho), subtitles 1380-1520, bottom 1600-1920 platform UI (kuch nahi). Zoom wale segment par face bada/unar hota hai — card ki jagah usi hisaab se check karo
conflict_note: SkillMedev ke per-platform safe-area percentages (TikTok/Reels/Shorts ke insets) se ye alag number set hai — dono ek hi sach ke do roop hain; Step 3 me ek zone table final hogi
evidence_note: blazerior design-system ki zones table — is skill ke tested layout numbers
name: Card face ke upar — kabhi face PAR nahi (safe zones)
when: 1080x1920 vertical video me card/panel rakhte waqt
why: Aankhein dhakna sabse aam pehli-galti hai; safe zones platform UI se takraav bachate hain

action: Line me zyada se zyada 3 shabd rakho; 0.7s se bada pause nayi line tod de. Active (bola ja raha) shabd tint karo aur 8% bara karo (108% scale; 110% se aage line hilne lagti hai). Font size 72, WrapStyle 0 lazmi (2 par lambi line screen se bahar jati hai). Subtitle text proofread karo — galti picture me jal jaye to permanent hai
conflict_note: Caption ke teen mode is cluster me hain: ye word-level (3 shabd), SkillMedev ki phrase captions 32-42 chars/line (C-085 ke saath dekho), pifferologo ki 2-shabd chunks (C-098) — mode content ke hisaab se batega, Step 3 tay kare
evidence_note: blazerior make_ass.py ke constants (MAX_WORDS 3, MAX_GAP 0.7) — is pipeline ke shipped numbers
name: Word-level subtitles — line me zyada se zyada 3 shabd
when: Vertical video ke liye burned-in word-level subtitles banate waqt
why: Shabd-dar-shabd highlight bolne ki gati se milta hai; zyada shabd aur galat wrap padhne ko marta hai

action: Final loudnorm I=-14 LUFS, TP=-1.5, LRA=11 rakho (two-pass zyada accurate hai). Isse shaant = amateurish, isse tez = platform khud neeche kar dega
evidence_note: Platform loudness standard ke roop me widely documented; blazerior cookbook bhi yahi spec deta hai (mean ~-18 dB expected after loudnorm)
name: Loudness −14 LUFS (social standard)
when: Social platforms ke liye final audio normalize karte waqt
why: Reels/TikTok/Shorts ka normalization target yahi hai; platform ki apni ceiling se ladna bekaar hai

action: Grade aankh se andaze par mat chuno: ek frame nikalo, candidate grades us par chalao, frames ko stack (hstack) karke saath-saath dekho, phir chuno. Grade moderate rakho — 8-bit phone footage par aggressive curves gradients par banding la dete hain (khaaskar subject ke peeche wali deewaar par)
conflict_note: pifferologo ke CDL reasoning (C-097) se milta hai — dono 'ek badlav, phir dekho' kehte hain
evidence_note: blazerior cookbook ki method rule
name: Grade tulna karke chuno, moderate rakho
when: Colour grade tay karte waqt
why: Akele frame par achha lagne wala grade তুলna me hi sach batata hai; banding ek baar render ho to poora video kharab

action: Base grade ye rakho: eq contrast=1.13, brightness=0.012, saturation=1.07, gamma=1.07; curves se shadows uthao (0.22→0.285) aur halka warm (red up, blue down); vignette=PI/9 (subtle; PI/5 strong hai); unsharp 5:5:0.45 scale/crop ki softness ke liye. Alternatives: neutral punch (contrast 1.12, sat 1.06), warm cinematic, pastel/film fade, ya ready .cube LUT (lut3d)

action: Cue speech ke saath aaye aur usi ke saath jaye; screen par kam se kam ~1s, zyada se zyada ~7s (lamba ho to baanto).
